component.name: keypaste
component.summary: AI agents get your secrets only when you say yes

description.p: keypaste keeps your passwords, API keys and project values in a KeePass file on your computer, with no account. When an AI agent such as Claude Code needs a secret, it asks for that one value, and you allow or deny it.
The keypaste desktop app opens the same KDBX vaults as the keypaste CLI, locks when idle and keeps copied secrets on the clipboard only briefly.
